artifacts.name: Ahiram Sarcophagus Linear Inscription
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: Carved Limestone · Iron Age I (c. 1000 BCE)
artifacts.description: 38-word inscription carved on the rim and lid in the early Phoenician phonetic linear alphabet, warning grave robbers and preserving the father of modern alphabets.

artifacts.name: Temple of the Obelisks Gilded Bronze Figurines
artifacts.nativeName: تماثيل البرونز المذهبة في معبد المسلات
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: Cast Bronze & Gold Leaf · Middle Bronze Age (c. 1800 BCE)
artifacts.description: Distinctive conical-headdress figurines deposited in stone jars under the courtyard floor, representing Phoenician deity Resheph and worshippers.
artifacts.provenance: National Museum of Beirut & Louvre Museum

artifacts.name: Silver Shekel (Tetradrachm) of Melqart
artifacts.nativeName: شيكل صور الفضي - ملقرت والحصان المجنح
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: High-Purity Cast Silver (95%) · Hellenistic / Iron Standard (c. 126 BCE – 66 CE)
artifacts.description: Laureate head of Heracles-Melqart riding a winged sea-horse over waves, reverse showing Egyptian eagle and ship's prow.
artifacts.provenance: American University of Beirut Museum & British Museum

artifacts.name: Marsala Punic Warship Joinery & Ram
artifacts.nativeName: أخشاب سفينة مرسى علي البونية ونظام اللسان والنقرة
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: Pine & Oak with Bronze Nails · 3rd century BCE (c. 241 BCE)
artifacts.description: Intact warship stern and keel exhibiting precision mortise-and-tenon joints, dunnage markings in painted Phoenician letters, and lead hull sheathing.
artifacts.provenance: Museo Archeologico Baglio Anselmi, Marsala, Sicily

artifacts.name: Sidonian Core-Formed Glass Amphoriskos
artifacts.nativeName: قارورة زجاجية صيدونية مشكلة على قالب طيني
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: Cobalt Blue Glass with Yellow/White Thread · Persian Period (c. 5th century BCE)
artifacts.description: Dark blue perfume vessel decorated with combed festoon chevrons, crafted by trailing molten glass around a removable organic sand core.
artifacts.provenance: The Metropolitan Museum of Art & Louvre Museum

artifacts.name: Imperial Tyrian Purple Dyed Wool Skein
artifacts.materialAndPeriod: Spun Wool Dyed with 6,6'-dibromoindigo · Iron Age Luxury
artifacts.description: Non-fading imperial crimson-purple dyed wool extracted from hypobranchial glands of Hexaplex trunculus mollusks, prized above gold across ancient royalty.
artifacts.provenance: Attested in Ugaritic and Assyrian tribute texts; dye installations excavated at Minet el-Faouqar, Tyre.
